properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1022464

Nearest City: High Point, NC
Location: 510 WEST GRIMES AVENUE 510 WEST GRIMES AVENUE
Incident Type: FIXED

Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: INNOSPEC ACTIVE CHEMICALS
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 35.950470, -80.009456 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 15000 gallons
Report Description
AN UNDERGROUND PIPE CONNECTING WASH WATER FROM THE FACILITY TO HIGH POINT SANITARY SEWER RUPTURED ALLOWING WASH WATER TO ENTER A NEARBY STREAM. THE 15,000 GALLONS OF WASH WATER RELEASED CONTAINED SMALL AMOUNTS OF THE FOLLOWING CHEMICALS: OLI-9900 (USED AS A FUEL ADDITIVE), TIXOGEL (ADDITIVE FOR PERSONAL CARE PRODUCTS), PUREACT I-78C (USED FOR MANUFACTURE OF PERSONAL CARE PRODUCTS) AND IDP-1388 (USED FOR MANUFACTURE OF COSMETICS). HIGH POINT, NC FIRE DEPARTMENT, HIGH POINT LAB/PRETREATMENT, GUILFORD COUNTY PUBLIC HEALTH, A&D ENVIRONMENTAL AND INNOSPEC PERSONNEL WERE ON SCENE. THE PRODUCT RELEASE DISCOLORED THE WATER IN THE STREAM BUT DID NOT CAUSE A FISH KILL. INFORMATION ABOUT THE RELEASE AND CLEAN-UP ACTIVITIES WERE REPORTED TO EPA REGION IV. THE RELEASED PRODUCT WAS PUMPED FROM THE STREAM TO HIGH POINT SANITARY SEWER.

THE 15,000 GALLONS OF WASH WATER RELEASED CONTAINED SMALL AMOUNTS OF THE FOLLOWING CHEMICALS: OLI-9900 (USED AS A FUEL ADDITIVE), TIXOGEL (ADDITIVE FOR PERSONAL CARE PRODUCTS), PUREACT I-78C (USED FOR MANUFACTURE OF PERSONAL CARE PRODUCTS) AND IDP-1388 (USED FOR MANUFACTURE OF COSMETICS). HIGH POINT, NC FIRE DEPARTMENT, HIGH POINT LAB/PRETREATMENT, GUILFORD COUNTY PUBLIC HEALTH, A&D ENVIRONMENTAL AND INNOSPEC PERSONNEL WERE ON SCENE. THE PRODUCT RELEASE DISCOLORED THE WATER IN THE STREAM BUT DID NOT CAUSE A FISH KILL. INFORMATION ABOUT THE RELEASE AND CLEAN-UP ACTIVITIES WERE REPORTED TO EPA REGION IV. THE RELEASED PRODUCT WAS PUMPED FROM THE STREAM TO HIGH POINT SANITARY SEWER.
